body.prompt: Close-up of a half-open old wooden wardrobe drawer at home, inside a small red velvet box holding a tiny pure gold baby ring (Korean first-birthday ring), soft morning light falling on the gold, folded linen around it.
An antique brass balance scale on a wooden desk: on one pan a small gold ring, on the other pan a small stack of plain paper banknotes and a bank passbook, the scale almost level.
New York financial district at dusk in 2008, tall bank towers, worried office workers in coats crossing the street, newspapers blowing on the sidewalk, tense atmosphere.
A crowded 1980 American coin and bullion shop, people in late-1970s coats lining up at the counter holding small gold coins, warm tungsten light, vintage feel.

A single road splitting into two paths across hills: one short path climbing quickly to a sunlit hilltop with a glowing gold bar, the other a very long winding path disappearing into distant mountains.
Winter 1998 in Seoul, a long line of ordinary Korean people in thick coats waiting outside a bank branch, each holding a small cloth pouch or jewelry box, breath visible in cold air, hopeful mood.
A dark trading room with many blank glowing monitors showing falling line charts drawn as simple red lines with no numbers, a lone trader holding his head.
Close-up of a computer chip on a circuit board cracking, with a simple downward red arrow line drawn above it, dramatic light.
An investor at night sitting on a sofa staring at a smartphone with a red glowing blank screen, a gold coin on the coffee table next to the phone, anxious mood.
A huge oil tanker crossing a hazy strait at sunset, smoke on the horizon, tense geopolitical mood.
A grand old investment bank building in Manhattan at night in March 2008, lights on in a few windows, rain on the pavement, a sense of crisis.
Office workers in suits walking out of a glass skyscraper lobby carrying cardboard boxes of personal belongings, September 2008, camera flashes from press in the distance.
Chaotic trading floor in 2008, paper sell orders flying in the air, traders shouting into phones, a few small gold bars sliding off a desk.
A neoclassical white marble central bank building in Washington DC in December snow, quiet and solemn, bare trees.
Inside a bank vault, stacks of gold bars glowing brightly under a warm spotlight, deep shadows around, triumphant mood.
An empty city street in spring 2020 during the pandemic, closed shop shutters, a single pedestrian in a face mask, quiet eerie mood.
December 1997 in Seoul, a currency exchange counter with a blank price board, worried Korean families watching a television in a bank lobby, winter coats.
A wooden tray on a bank counter piled with donated gold jewelry: tiny baby rings, wedding rings, gold necklaces and a gold medal, warm light, hands of different people placing items.
Sealed wooden crates being loaded onto a cargo plane at an airport at night in 1998, guards and workers, floodlights.
A balance scale on a table: a heavy small gold bar on one side outweighing a large pile of crumpled paper banknotes on the other side, dramatic contrast.
A mountain of gold bars and gold jewelry piled high in a grand hall, glowing, people looking up small in the foreground, awe.
1979 United States, a very long line of old 1970s cars waiting at a gas station, people standing by their cars, hot summer haze.
Silhouette from behind of a tall man in a suit standing at a window of a stately office in 1980, looking over Washington, cigar smoke curling, no face visible.

A 1980s Korean first-birthday party at home: a baby in traditional hanbok seated at a table with rice cakes and fruit, relatives gently placing a tiny gold ring on the baby's finger, warm nostalgic film photo feel, faces soft.
Close-up of an antique brass balance scale exactly level, one pan holding a small gold bar and the other a stack of coins, still and balanced, calm light.
A desk calendar open to December with one day circled in pen, a cup of coffee and a newspaper beside it, morning light, no readable text.
A balance scale tipping slightly, with a road behind it splitting left toward a snowy 1980s city and right toward a sunlit modern city, symbolic.
A huge central bank underground gold vault with rows of gold bar stacks on shelves, a worker in a white coat checking a clipboard, cool light.
A small gold bar sitting safely under an open umbrella while heavy rain falls around it on a city street at night, symbolic of insurance.
A Korean neighborhood gold jewelry shop counter, a small digital scale weighing a tiny gold ring, the jeweler's hands with tweezers, glass display cases, warm light.
A supermarket shopping cart full of groceries in an aisle, a hand holding a receipt, everyday life, soft light.
A long road stretching across decades of landscape from a 1980 town to a modern skyline, with a single gold bar resting on a milestone in the foreground.
Morning at home: a person's hands holding a smartphone with a blank glowing banking screen next to an open wooden drawer with a small red ring box, coffee cup, soft sunlight.
Dramatic macro close-up of a tiny pure gold baby ring on dark wood, strong side light, deep shadows, high contrast, the ring placed in the right half of the frame.
Dramatic wide shot of a long line of Korean people in 1998 winter coats holding gold jewelry boxes outside a bank, faces determined, placed in the right half, darker left side.
A simple ornate gold pectoral cross on a chain resting on a folded white cloth on a 1998 bank counter, a bank clerk's hands carefully receiving it, soft respectful light, no faces.
A modern Seoul currency exchange booth on a busy street, a blank glowing rate board, passers-by with shopping bags, evening light.
2008 financial crisis: a crowded city sidewalk at night in front of a bank with dark windows, people in coats looking at a large blank glowing stock ticker board, rain, tense.
A dim 1980s jewelry shop window display with gold chains and rings on velvet, dusty glass, a quiet empty street reflected, melancholic mood of falling prices.
1999 London: rows of gold bars on a cart being wheeled out of a historic stone vault corridor by workers in suits, cool light, sense of selling off.
An antique brass balance scale clearly tilting to one side, a small gold bar on the lower pan and coins on the higher pan, a storm sky window behind, suspenseful.
